q: 三人行，必有我师焉。
qEn: Among any three people, one can be my teacher.
author: 孔子

q: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。
qEn: Learning without thought is blind; thought without learning is perilous.
author: 孔子

q: 己所不欲，勿施于人。
qEn: Do not impose on others what you would not want yourself.
author: 孔子

q: 千里之行，始于足下。
qEn: A journey of a thousand li begins under one's feet.
author: 老子

q: 天行健，君子以自强不息。
qEn: As heaven moves with vigor, the noble strive unceasingly.
author: 《周易》

q: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
qEn: The road ahead is long; I shall search high and low.
author: 屈原

q: 生于忧患，死于安乐。
qEn: One thrives in adversity and perishes in ease.
author: 孟子

q: 大风起兮云飞扬。
qEn: A great wind rises, the clouds are swept along.
author: 刘邦

q: 燕雀安知鸿鹄之志哉！
qEn: How can the swallow know the ambition of the swan!
author: 司马迁

q: 究天人之际，通古今之变。
qEn: To probe the relation of heaven and man, and grasp the changes of past and present.
author: 司马迁

q: 老骥伏枥，志在千里。
qEn: An old steed in the stable still aspires to gallop a thousand li.
author: 曹操

q: 鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已。
qEn: Bend to the task until one's dying day.
srcEn: Later Memorial on Dispatching the Army
author: 诸葛亮

q: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山。
qEn: Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, I gaze at the southern hills.
author: 陶渊明

q: 会当凌绝顶，一览众山小。
qEn: I shall reach the summit and see all other peaks as small.
author: 杜甫

q: 长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海。
qEn: A time will come to ride the wind and break the waves, hoisting a cloud-sail across the sea.
author: 李白

q: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。
qEn: Be first in worrying about the world's troubles and last in enjoying its pleasures.
author: 范仲淹

q: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。
qEn: May we all be blessed with longevity; though far apart, we share the same moon.
author: 苏轼

q: 人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青。
qEn: Since ancient times, who has not died? Let my loyal heart shine in the annals.
author: 文天祥

q: 王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁。
qEn: When the armies retake the Central Plains, do not forget to tell your father at the family rites.
author: 陆游

q: 粉骨碎身浑不怕，要留清白在人间。
qEn: Though crushed to dust I do not fear, so long as purity remains in the world.
author: 于谦

q: 天下兴亡，匹夫有责。
qEn: Every common man shares responsibility for the rise and fall of the realm.
author: 顾炎武

q: 苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之。
qEn: If it benefits the nation, I would face life or death — how could I shirk it for fortune or fear?
author: 林则徐
